feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking deployment feature to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for various frontend files describing styling, pages, legal components, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how the Smart Salon app is deployed on ICP and where live canister URLs appear.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus light/dark OKLCH theme variables and global background/text rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, icons, root container, and main script loader.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component enabling dark mode and rendering the LandingPage.
frontend/src/components/legal/ContactVie: Contact section with email and phone cards using shared CONTACT_INFO data.
frontend/src/components/legal/LegalModal: Reusable modal wrapper with scrollable content for displaying legal documents.
frontend/src/components/legal/PrivacyPol: Structured privacy policy content using COMPANY_INFO and CONTACT_INFO constants.
Terms & Conditions component outlining usage rules, bookings, payments, and responsibilities.
frontend/src/content/legal.ts: Exports shared CONTACT_INFO and COMPANY_INFO objects for legal components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, wrapping AuthClient and exposing login, clear, and identity state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for a dark luxury theme with gold accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the Smart Salon landing page with header, hero section, CTAs, and legal modal handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and plugins for the project’s theme.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, requirements, and design guidelines for building the Smart Salon landing page and related content.
